descFull: Open-source HeyMelody alternative for Android, Windows and Linux. Control OnePlus / OPPO / realme earbuds over Bluetooth, no root: battery, noise cancellation (ANC), equalizer, hearing profile, gestures, wear detection, find my earbuds, dual connection, low latency mode, widgets and a tray icon.
